## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name is not `main` or `dev`
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`uv run pytest tests`)
- [ ] Code is formatted (`uv run ruff format && uv run ruff check --fix`)
- [ ] Code coverage is not reduced too much
- [ ] New functions/classes have type annotations and docstrings
- [ ] If a new method is implemented, a reference to the paper is added to the [References page](https://torch-uncertainty.github.io/references.html)
- [ ] Licensed code from external sources is explicitly attributed
